name: Ismael Fong
life: “I still remember waiting for my father beside a gate nobody used.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the blocks below Foundry Lofts, where Ismael checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I want to meet him at the gate so my mother can choose when to see him.
appearance: Ismael has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Look for close-cropped dark curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is an old plum windbreaker with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Ismael leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Ismael treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Ismael lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To let the mother choose the moment of contact.
family: Bianca Moreau is Ismael’s cousin. Ismael saves a place. Bianca chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The driving lesson fund*, Bianca says, “I voted to give the slot to a parent. The single person who lost gets up at four to visit her dad.”
connections: Adriana Diaz (child). One family welcome has to make room for both an adult's anger and a child's curiosity.

reactions.situation: The returning father wants a family photograph immediately
reactions.response: Ismael asks each household member privately whether they want to be in the picture.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Ismael asks everybody to retrace their own last ordinary actions before asking the young worker a question.
